description: This file defines a utility class 'Utils' within the GuzzleHttp namespace, providing various helper functions such as type description, header parsing, debugging, environment handling, and system configuration for the Guzzle HTTP client.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for common tasks used across Guzzle HTTP client operations, including type descriptions, header parsing, environment and system configuration, JSON handling, time measurement, and URI processing.

methods.name: describeType
methods.description: Returns a string describing the type of the input variable, including class name for objects, count for arrays, and normalized float representation.

methods.name: headersFromLines
methods.description: Parses header lines into an associative array of header names and values.

methods.name: debugResource
methods.description: Returns a resource for debugging purposes, either the provided resource, STDOUT, or a fallback to php://output.

methods.name: chooseHandler
methods.description: Selects and creates the most appropriate HTTP handler based on the environment, such as cURL, stream, or multi-handler.

methods.name: defaultUserAgent
methods.description: Generates the default User-Agent string for Guzzle HTTP requests.

methods.name: defaultCaBundle
methods.description: Determines the default CA certificate bundle file path based on system configuration, deprecated in future versions.

methods.name: normalizeHeaderKeys
methods.description: Creates a mapping of lowercase header names to their original casing.

methods.name: isHostInNoProxy
methods.description: Checks whether a host matches any rules in the no-proxy list, including exact, suffix, or wildcard matches.

methods.name: jsonDecode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into PHP data, throwing an exception on error.

methods.name: jsonEncode
methods.description: Encodes PHP data into JSON string, throwing an exception on error.

methods.name: currentTime
methods.description: Returns the current UNIX timestamp utilizing hrtime() or microtime() depending on PHP version.

methods.name: idnUriConvert
methods.description: Converts the hostname portion of a URI to its ASCII-compatible encoding (punycode) for internationalized domain names, validating errors.
